args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16.
- Moss's coverage digest (2026-05-18) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old label is still showing in that report.
- The label change is on the handoff list, but the older name is making supervisors search twice.
- Could the saved report label be updated to match the new name? Happy to pass along details.

Thanks,
Sofia
